title: The Best Lake Tahoe Airplane Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning beauty of Lake Tahoe from above on a scenic mountain flight flown by local, experienced mountain pilots. North Tahoe Aviation is owned & operated by a 20+ year local ski/mountain guide, bringing over a decade of mountain flying experience and local knowledge. 

This flight is ~30 minutes long and can accommodate 1 - 3 passengers. You won't forget this Lake Tahoe mountain flying experience! Discover the stunning scenery of Lake Tahoe and the rugged skyline of the Pacific Crest Trail.

Highlights: Lake Tahoe’s North Shore and the Sierra Crest. Including: Sand harbor, Incline Village, Kings Beach, Tinker’s Knob, Anderson Peak, Sugar Bowl Resort, Palisades Tahoe, Donner Summit & Donner Lake.

- Scenic flights showcasing Lake Tahoe's iconic sights
- Depart from Truckee Tahoe Airport for a unique experience
- Ideal for small groups with seating for up to three passengers
- Perfect for both first-time visitors and returning travelers
